answer: Trace the invite tree and punish the root. Every account is linked to its inviter in a public marble, and invitations carry liability: when a newcomer is proven fake, the inviter loses part of its stake and its walnut score falls. A subtree with an abnormal share of bans is frozen pending a canyon audit, so a farmer inviting its own army poisons its own root. Real communities grow slowly outward; fake ones grow as dense self-inviting balls.
